documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Intimation Under Regulation 8(2) Of SEBI (Prohibition Of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
Corporate Action - Fixation Of Record Date For Interim Dividend
Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30 September 2026.

analysis.summary: R R Kabel Limited reported its highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax in Q1 FY27, driven by strong performance in the Wires & Cables segment. Management noted supportive end-market demand despite ongoing volatility in metal prices and foreign exchange. The FMEG segment also achieved an operational breakeven during the quarter, supported by premiumization and revenue growth. The company remains positive on the long-term demand outlook and is progressing with its planned capacity expansions. R R Kabel reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue of 31,682 Mn in Q1 FY27, representing a 54% growth YoY driven by healthy domestic demand and export growth.

guidance.claim: The company maintains its overall margin guidance of 10.5% by FY28.
guidance.quote: So we'll remain there because while we endeavor to touch our double-digit margins for the year, but since it is early in the year, we continue to maintain our overall margin guidance of 10.5% by FY '28.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an overall volume growth of around 18% year-on-year for the current year.
guidance.quote: So this year also, we are expecting around 18% volume growth.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a top-line growth of around 20% in the FMEG business.
guidance.quote: So first of all, we are targeting growth of around 20% in FMEG business and also achieving breakeven on sustainable basis for this year and then make this business profitable in coming 2, 3 years on continuous and sustainable basis with top line growth of around 20% year-on-year.

guidance.claim: The company remains on track to achieve breakeven in the FMEG segment in FY27.
guidance.quote: Importantly, FMEG losses have reduced as compared to last year, and we remain on track to achieve breakeven in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management targets volume growth in the range of 16% to 18% for the Wires and Cable segment.
guidance.quote: On a yearly basis, whatever the prediction we have given on like our yearly basis, volume growth will be like, always remain better than industry growth and whatever we have projected in our slides in the range of 16% to 18%.

guidance.claim: The company targets to achieve 10.5% EBIT margins in the wire and cable segment by FY28.
guidance.quote: Even going forward, we are like quite positive to achieve our target of 10.5% EBIT margins in wire and cable segment by FY28.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting value growth of around 20% to 25% in the FMEG business for the upcoming year.
guidance.quote: It seems, in this year, if everything remains same then, we are targeting value growth of around 20%-25% in FMEG business.

demand_outlook.claim: In fans, volumes were broadly flat year-on-year, but revenue increased due to higher realization and a better product mix.
demand_outlook.quote: In fans, volumes were broadly flat year-on-year, but revenue increased due to higher realization and a better product mix.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains positive about the long-term demand outlook driven by infrastructure development, housing, industrial investment, electrification, and the shift towards organized products.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain positive about the long-term demand outlook. Infrastructure development, housing, industrial investment, electrification and the shift towards organized and compliant products continue to support the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth was led by healthy domestic demand and export growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Delivered highest-ever quarterly revenue, growing 54% YoY, led by healthy domestic demand and export growth

demand_outlook.claim: The Wires & Cables segment growth was backed by impressive volume growth, strong execution and favorable industry dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: Continues to outperform by delivering growth of 57% YoY on the back of impressive volume growth, strong execution and favorable industry dynamics

demand_outlook.claim: FMEG revenue growth was supported by continued demand for premium and new products across key categories and ongoing distribution expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong growth in revenue, supported by continued demand for premium and new products across key categories and ongoing distribution expansion

demand_outlook.claim: Industry demand remains supportive while export market continued to perform well.
demand_outlook.quote: Industry demand remains supportive while export market continued to perform well.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand remained healthy while export demand was relatively stronger during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remained healthy while export demand was relatively stronger during the quarter, benefiting from our established global presence, our quality, and diversified market reach.

capex_expansion.claim: New capacities are expected to be added during the current quarter in Silvassa.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capacity expansion program is also progressing as planned with new capacities expected to be added during the current quarter in Silvassa.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to deploy around INR600 crores to INR650 crores of capex in the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of which, like last year, we did around INR300 crores, and this year, major of that expansion will be executed and as of INR600 crores to INR650 crores will be deployed in this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The INR1,200 crore capex program for FY26 to FY28 is progressing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: Our INR1,200 crores capex program for FY26 to FY28 is progressing as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex program is primarily focused on expanding cable capacity along with wire capacity and improving operating efficiencies.
capex_expansion.quote: The program is primarily focused on expanding cable capacity along with wire capacity and improving operating efficiencies.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested almost INR300 crores in capex in FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: What we have planned, like investment of INR1,200 crore, out of which, almost INR300 crores we have invested in FY26 already.

margins_costs.claim: The operating EBITDA margin improved to 9% compared to 7% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: The operating EBITDA margin improved to 9% compared to 7% in Q1 FY '26.

margins_costs.claim: The wire and cable segment profit margin improved to 9.9% compared with 7.6% in the corresponding quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: The segment profit margin improved to 9.9% compared with 7.6% in the corresponding quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: Almost 25% of FMEG revenues are coming from the premium product side.
margins_costs.quote: Almost 25% of our revenues are coming from premium product side.

margins_costs.claim: Operating EBITDA increased 99% YoY with margin expansion driven by improved business mix, margin expansion, cost disciplined and execution efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: Operating EBITDA increased 99% YoY, with EBITDA margin expanding by 205 bps YoY, driven by improved business mix, margin expansion, cost disciplined and execution efficiencies

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin improved by 212 bps YoY, reflecting sustained profitability improvement.
margins_costs.quote: PAT surged 129% YoY, with PAT margin improving by 212 bps YoY, reflecting sustained profitability improvement

margins_costs.claim: Segment profit in Wires & Cables increased due to margin expansion and effective cost management.
margins_costs.quote: Segment profit increased 105% YoY, driven by margin expansion and effective cost management

margins_costs.claim: Wires & Cables segment margin expanded due to improved product mix, disciplined commodity management and operating efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: Segment margin expanded by 232 bps YoY, reflecting improved product mix, disciplined commodity management and operating efficiencies

margins_costs.claim: FMEG segment achieved operational breakeven, marking a significant milestone in the FMEG business transformation.
margins_costs.quote: Achieved operational breakeven, marking a significant milestone in the FMEG business transformation

margins_costs.claim: FMEG segment profitability improved substantially YoY driven by premium products and operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: Segment profitability improved substantially on a YoY basis, driven by premium products and operating leverage

margins_costs.claim: Profitability improved on the back of operating leverage and disciplined cost management despite raw material volatility and global turmoil.
margins_costs.quote: Profitability improved on the back of operating leverage and disciplined cost management despite raw material volatility and global turmoil.

margins_costs.claim: Segment profit for FY26 in the Wires and Cable segment was supported by scale benefits, effective management of price volatility, and operational efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: For FY26, segment profit stood at INR775.6 crores compared to INR496.5 crores in FY25, up 56.2% year-on-year, supported by scale benefits, effective management of price volatility, and operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall Wires & Cable volumes grew by 17% year-on-year, with cables growing faster at more than 25% volume growth and wires at approximately 12%.
orders_capacity.quote: Overall, Wires & Cable volumes grew by 17% year-on-year with similar growth seen both in domestic and export markets. Cables grew significantly faster with more than 25% volume growth, while volume growth in wires was approximately 12%.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for cables was almost 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: where like earlier, we had capacity utilization of almost 90%.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for wires is around 65% to 70%.
In the cable segment, utilization is at optimum levels of more than 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: It means since in cable already we are at optimum utilization of more than 90% so to meet this growth plan we will keep adding capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently has the capability to manufacture up to 66 KV of cable.
orders_capacity.quote: Right now, we can make up to 66 KV of cable.

orders_capacity.claim: The new capex plan will enable the company to build up to 220 KV of cable.
orders_capacity.quote: With new capex plan, we'll be able to achieve capability to build up to 220 KV, which is like lower end of EHV or higher end of HV side of the cable with this capex plan of INR1,200 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital days remained broadly stable at 50 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital days remained broadly stable at 50 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The balance sheet and working capital position remained healthy during the year, supported by tight control on inventory and receivables.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet and working capital position remained healthy during the year, supported by tight control on inventory and receivables.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter continued to see volatility in metal prices and foreign exchange, along with uncertainty across global markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter continued to see volatility in metal prices and foreign exchange, along with uncertainty across global markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain-related issues still remain, though management is confident of overcoming those challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, supply chain-related issues still remain, but we are confident of overcoming those challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: There was a negative impact on volume growth in the last part of Q2.
risks_headwinds.quote: So if I consider only last part of Q2, then there was negative impact in volume growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heightened geopolitical tension created some uncertainty in global trade conditions and volatility in input costs during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter was marked by heightened geopolitical tension, which created some uncertainty in global trade conditions and volatility in input costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material prices, particularly copper, aluminium, and PVC remained volatile during the period, while currency movement and freight cost added pressure across the value chain.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, raw material prices, particularly copper, aluminium, and PVC remained volatile during the period, while currency movement and freight cost added pressure across the value chain.

risks_headwinds.claim: FMEG volume growth was impacted by bad weather conditions during the year.
risks_headwinds.quote: There were two major reasons. One, of course, like, the volumes what we were expecting due to bad weather and it could not be achieved.
